messages.subject: Re: qtbase build problems on FreeBSD
messages.body_plain:
Looked into this a little. I would have thought that FindQt4 in cmake is supposed to add the necessary include paths for the OpenGL installation. I looked at the script though and, while I see where it adds the necessary OpenGL libs, I can't find treatment of the include paths. In fact, I can't find management of the include paths for ANY of the external dependencies, but OpenGL might be the only one where the underlying headers are included.

The reason those other programs build is that they probably explicitly lookup the necessary OpenGL paths/libs, given that they are directly calling OpenGL.  I guess I will just do the same.

Michael

messages.subject: Re: qtbase build problems on FreeBSD
messages.body_plain:
On 13.02.2012 15:32 (UTC+1), Michael Lawrence wrote:
> Looked into this a little. I would have thought that FindQt4 in cmake is
> supposed to add the necessary include paths for the OpenGL installation.
> I looked at the script though and, while I see where it adds the
> necessary OpenGL libs, I can't find treatment of the include paths. In
> fact, I can't find management of the include paths for ANY of the
> external dependencies, but OpenGL might be the only one where the
> underlying headers are included.
>
> The reason those other programs build is that they probably explicitly
> lookup the necessary OpenGL paths/libs, given that they are directly
> calling OpenGL.  I guess I will just do the same.

If I understand you right, you will try to change the lookup method for
the OpenGL stuff within qtbase?

On FreeBSD the QtOpenGL header files are located under
/usr/local/include/qt4/QtOpenGL/, but in
/usr/local/share/cmake/Modules/FindQt4.cmake there is defined (line 243):

#  QT_QTOPENGL_INCLUDE_DIR     Path to "include/QtOpenGL"

I think that is the same FindQt4 file found on different systems?

Please let me know if you need more (FreeBSD) information or if I can
test something.

Rainer

On Mon, Feb 13, 2012 at 1:27 PM, Rainer Hurling <rhu...@gwdg.de> wrote:
> On 13.02.2012 15:32 (UTC+1), Michael Lawrence wrote:
> > Looked into this a little. I would have thought that FindQt4 in cmake is
> > supposed to add the necessary include paths for the OpenGL installation.
> > I looked at the script though and, while I see where it adds the
> > necessary OpenGL libs, I can't find treatment of the include paths. In
> > fact, I can't find management of the include paths for ANY of the
> > external dependencies, but OpenGL might be the only one where the
> > underlying headers are included.
> >
> > The reason those other programs build is that they probably explicitly
> > lookup the necessary OpenGL paths/libs, given that they are directly
> > calling OpenGL.  I guess I will just do the same.
>
> If I understand you right, you will try to change the lookup method for the OpenGL stuff within qtbase?
>

This is correct.

> On FreeBSD the QtOpenGL header files are located under /usr/local/include/qt4/QtOpenGL/, but in /usr/local/share/cmake/Modules/FindQt4.cmake there is defined (line 243):
>
> #  QT_QTOPENGL_INCLUDE_DIR     Path to "include/QtOpenGL"
>
> I think that is the same FindQt4 file found on different systems?
>

Yes, this is getting the include directory for the QtOpenGL module. Not the actual OpenGL include path. An argument could be made that find_package(QtOpenGL) should automatically add the OpenGL include path. But it only adds the lib arguments to the linker line.

The version of qtbase that will soon appear on CRAN will hopefully have a fix.

Michael

>     for the OpenGL stuff within qtbase?
>
>
> This is correct.
>
>     On FreeBSD the QtOpenGL header files are located under

>     /usr/local/include/qt4/__QtOpenGL/, but in
>     /usr/local/share/cmake/__Modules/FindQt4.cmake there is defined

>     (line 243):
>
>     #  QT_QTOPENGL_INCLUDE_DIR     Path to "include/QtOpenGL"
>
>     I think that is the same FindQt4 file found on different systems?
>
>
> Yes, this is getting the include directory for the QtOpenGL module. Not
> the actual OpenGL include path. An argument could be made that
> find_package(QtOpenGL) should automatically add the OpenGL include path.
> But it only adds the lib arguments to the linker line.

Ok, I understand.

> The version of qtbase that will soon appear on CRAN will hopefully have
> a fix.

That sounds good! I am looking forward to use it on FreeBSD.

Rainer

messages.body_plain:
Hi guys,

I volunteered to give a talk at the PAWS (predictive analytics) conference in SF on Monday. I'm going to be talking about some of the low-level infrastructure (qtpaint, plumbr) for interactive graphics. To keep the audience engaged though I'm going to need some high-level demos of the functionality. I could show some of visnab, but I think it's too biological. Maybe you guys in the cranvas project have some more digestible demos that I could borrow? Preferably, stuff that actually uses a "data pipeline", even better if the data is "large". Maybe something with a dynamic filter?

Thanks,
Michael
